# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(mapgl)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(mapboxapi)
```

# Initial map of stadiums as points

```{r}
# Load and convert to sf points
stadiums <- read_csv("data/Major_League_Baseball_Stadiums.csv") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"), crs = 4326)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("MLB Stadiums Map"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      # Optional: add filters later here
      helpText("Map of MLB stadiums as points")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      mapboxglOutput("stadium_map", height = "700px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$stadium_map <- renderMapboxgl({
    mapboxgl(bounds = stadiums) |>
      add_circle_layer(
        id = "stadiums",
        source = stadiums,
        circle_radius = 8,
        circle_color = "#FF5722",
        circle_stroke_width = 2,
        circle_stroke_color = "white"
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

# Adding tooltip

```{r}
# Load and convert to sf points
stadiums <- read_csv("data/Major_League_Baseball_Stadiums.csv") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"), crs = 4326) %>%
  mutate(
    tooltip_text = paste0(
      "<b>", NAME, "</b><br>",
      "Team: ", TEAM, "<br>",
      "City: ", CITY, ", ", STATE, "<br>",
      "Capacity: ", CAPACITY
    )
  )

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("MLB Stadiums Map"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      helpText("Hover over a stadium point to see details.")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      mapboxglOutput("stadium_map", height = "700px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$stadium_map <- renderMapboxgl({
    mapboxgl(bounds = stadiums, style = mapbox_style("light")) |>
      add_circle_layer(
        id = "stadiums",
        source = stadiums,
        circle_radius = 8,
        circle_color = "#FF5722",
        circle_stroke_width = 2,
        circle_stroke_color = "white",
        tooltip = "tooltip_text",
        popup = "tooltip_text"
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

# Beginning customization of colors

```{r}
stadiums <- read_csv("data/Major_League_Baseball_Stadiums.csv") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"), crs = 4326) %>%
  mutate(
    tooltip_text = paste0(
      "<b>", NAME, "</b><br>",
      "Team: ", TEAM, "<br>",
      "City: ", CITY, ", ", STATE, "<br>",
      "Capacity: ", CAPACITY
    ),
    color = ifelse(LEAGUE == "National", "#1f78b4", "#e31a1c")  # blue for National, red for American
  )

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("MLB Stadiums Map"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      helpText("Hover over a stadium point to see details.")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      mapboxglOutput("stadium_map", height = "700px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$stadium_map <- renderMapboxgl({
    mapboxgl(bounds = stadiums) |>
      add_circle_layer(
        id = "stadiums",
        source = stadiums,
        circle_radius = 8,
        circle_color = get_column("color"),
        circle_stroke_width = 2,
        circle_stroke_color = "white",
        tooltip = "tooltip_text",
        popup = "tooltip_text"
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

# Creating driving times

```{r}
# Load stadium data and convert to sf points
stadiums <- read_csv("data/Major_League_Baseball_Stadiums.csv") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"), crs = 4326) %>%
  mutate(
    tooltip_text = paste0(
      "<b>", NAME, "</b><br>",
      "Team: ", TEAM, "<br>",
      "City: ", CITY, ", ", STATE, "<br>",
      "Capacity: ", CAPACITY
    ),
    color = ifelse(LEAGUE == "National", "#1f78b4", "#e31a1c")  # Blue for National, red for American
  )

# Extract lon/lat from geometry column (EPSG:4326)
coords <- sf::st_coordinates(stadiums$geometry)
lon <- coords[,1]
lat <- coords[,2]

times <- c(15, 30, 60)

# Generate isochrones safely with error handling
isochrone_list <- list()
for (mins in times) {
  iso_for_time <- lapply(seq_along(lon), function(i) {
    tryCatch({
      poly <- mb_isochrone(c(lon[i], lat[i]), profile = "driving", time = mins)
      poly$minutes <- mins
      poly$stadium_id <- stadiums$OBJECTID[i]
      poly
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(paste("Error for stadium", i, "time", mins, ":", e$message))
      NULL
    })
  }) %>% compact()
  
  if(length(iso_for_time) > 0) {
    isochrone_list[[as.character(mins)]] <- do.call(rbind, iso_for_time)
  }
}
isochrones <- do.call(rbind, isochrone_list)

# Define colors for isochrones (with some transparency)
fill_colors <- c(
  "15" = "#33a02ccc",  # green
  "30" = "#ffdb4dcc",  # yellow
  "60" = "#e31a1ccc"   # red
)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("MLB Stadiums with Drive-Time Isochrones"),
  mainPanel(
    mapboxglOutput("stadium_map", height = "700px")
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$stadium_map <- renderMapboxgl({
    base_map <- mapboxgl(bounds = stadiums) |>  # default Mapbox style
      add_circle_layer(
        id = "stadiums",
        source = stadiums,
        circle_radius = 8,
        circle_color = get_column("color"),
        circle_stroke_width = 2,
        circle_stroke_color = "white",
        tooltip = "tooltip_text",
        popup = "tooltip_text"
      )
    
    # Add isochrone polygons by time interval if available
    if (exists("isochrones") && nrow(isochrones) > 0) {
      for (mins in times) {
        polys <- isochrones %>% filter(minutes == mins)
        
        if (nrow(polys) > 0) {
          base_map <- base_map |>
            add_source(id = paste0("iso_source_", mins), data = polys) |>
            add_fill_layer(
              id = paste0("iso_layer_", mins),
              source = paste0("iso_source_", mins),
              fill_color = fill_colors[as.character(mins)],
              fill_opacity = 0.3
            )
        }
      }
    } else {
      message("No isochrone polygons to display")
    }
    
    base_map
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

```
